title: AsyncContext proposal integration
body: This patch includes the three changes needed in DOM to work with AsyncContext and https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/13063: - support to pass a context to the "fire an event" logic - the `[PropagatesAsyncContextToEvents]` WebIDL extended attribute - propagation for `AbortSignal.timeout()`, which needs to propagate its context to the `abort` event I originally thought that we'd also need to handle the custom elements logic that is here in DOM (e.g. as part of the `move`) steps, but the changes in HTML are enough also for the algorithms defined in DOM. A more detailed description of this change can also be found at https://github.com/tc39/proposal-async-context/blob/main/web-integration/dom.md (in that folder I'm collecting "spec changes plans" for the various specs as I go through them). (part of this was originally in https://github.com/whatwg/dom/pull/1451, but I am taking over from Andreu and even with write access to their fork I don't fully have the right permission on that PR) --- - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * … * … - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * … - [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: … * Gecko: … * WebKit: … * Deno (only for aborting and events): … * Node.js (only for aborting and events): … - [ ] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: … - [ ] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
